mcp_tools.name: acp_protocol_integration_review
mcp_tools.title: ACP protocol integration review
mcp_tools.description: Submit an ACP integration manifest; get a deterministic INTEGRATION_SOUND / INTEGRATION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE review across seven sections (disambiguation and scope, adapter architecture, protocol surface, lifecycle correctness, streaming discipline, security, honesty/tests/upgrade path), including a computed flavour-recognition check against the skill's ACP-client / ACP-comm vocabulary, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The ACP integration manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

protocol.description: Flavour, disambiguation, spec-version and supported-subset evidence.

adapter.description: Adapter-architecture evidence (thin, single core at the edge, no business logic in the wire layer).

surface.description: Protocol-surface evidence, gated on the declared flavour (client flow/permissions or comm endpoints/typed message parts).

lifecycle.description: Session/run lifecycle evidence (unknown, cancels, errors, reconnects, no state leak).

streaming.description: Streaming-discipline evidence (ordered, bounded chunks, backpressure, clear terminal states).

security.description: Security evidence (remote-endpoint auth, input validation, output caps, sandboxed tool execution).

honesty.description: Honesty evidence (unimplemented modes noted, unsupported features not faked).

tests.description: Contract-test evidence (scripted handshake, lifecycle happy/error/cancel, in CI per protocol).

upgrade.description: Upgrade-path evidence (official-SDK path documented, adapter tests kept for swaps).

expect.notes: All 31 checks pass for ACP-client flavor. Computed flavor_status: acp_client.
